active_product_bottleneck.observation: Actual Builder preserves >9.33 MB Office saving, but corrected real parallel staging still misses the frozen 1.25x create ceiling (artifact 10790261113: 1.28531x). The safe physical-only existing-grammar mode1 oracle completed on 992f5675 and is fast (create 1.10040x, extract 0.85783x, RSS 1.00x, exact tree, all Deflate mode1) but saves only 5,651,816 B median: 60.55% of the >9.33 MB breakthrough, surrendering 39.45%. Existing r24 mode1 therefore cannot preserve the breakthrough without paying duplicate representation bytes.
active_product_bottleneck.next_discriminator: Retire physical-only r24 mode1 as the breakthrough-preserving representation. Move to the materially different authenticated-physical ownership frame: determine whether r25 physical records can make exact Deflate payloads first-class authenticated storage while preserving logical identities, locality, native portability and >9 MB gain without retaining decoded duplicates.

primary_question.hypothesis: First-class independently authenticated physical Deflate payloads can preserve the >9 MB hidden-ZIP gain while avoiding decoded-inner retention and the r24 mode0 whole-logical authentication/create debt.
primary_question.kill: No product credit until same-tree exactness, >9 MB gain retention, frozen create/extract/RSS/locality gates, corruption refusal, bounded decode units and native projection are demonstrated. Prefer the cheapest r25 oracle before product wiring.

frontier_candidates.question: Can r25 authenticated physical records own exact Deflate streams directly, with logical identity metadata separate from physical payload authentication, preserving >9 MB without whole-logical mode0 work?
If r25 fails, is the measured 5.65 MB / 1.1004x-create physical-only mode1 point useful as a bounded fallback portfolio member without displacing the stronger byte owner?

next_action: PARETOBONK r25 authenticated physical ownership before implementation. Reuse existing r25/Merkle physical-payload machinery if it can represent exact Deflate streams as independently authenticated physical records while preserving logical SHA/CRC and <=8x locality.
